muaythai.about: Muay Thai page: I started two years ago when a friend dragged me to our local gym. I was intimidated at first, scared of fighting and of the people there, but I was addicted by the first week. It feels like a physical version of chess and puzzle games. My Instagram feed is Muay Thai highlights, and I hung a bag from Facebook Marketplace in my backyard to train in the mornings. I also coach the beginner class

chess.about: Chess page: I played competitively all through elementary school, competed at regionals and got my rating to 1425 playing against adults, then had to focus on classical guitar. I still play online on chess.com and solve puzzles (rapid rating 1727, best puzzle rating 1840). You can play the head on the page

cycling.about: Cycling page: I only recently got into cycling. It started with a $20 Facebook Marketplace bike because London's buses are horrible, I got obsessed, then found a really nice track bike on Marketplace in Detroit, 2 hours away, rented a car and drove over to buy it. Now I bike to school every day and go on long rides. Has a 3D model of the bike you can spin, and a photo of me with it

Lindeman Lake (with Toto the dog), Panorama Ridge, Tunnel Bluffs, Quarry Rock, Buntzen Lake, Gros Morne (Tablelands, Western Brook Pond), Bonavista, Signal Hill, Cape Spear, Èze, Mount Heng and Lushan. speed-skating.about: Speed skating, on the hobbies list (no page of its own, hovering it shows a line): my main sport growing up. 1st at the BC provincials in my youth group, in the 100m, 200m, 400m and 1000m
